task: Bangkok six-place editorial pilot (research only; no live app data changed)
popularity_method: No citywide popularity measure has been collected. Coverage breadth is measured for batch selection only (windowed, publisher-family-deduped scan); it is a research-selection signal, never a popularity score.

entities.scope_notes: Administrative khet (~5.54 km², pop ~45,757 in 2020) with strongly distinct subareas: Silom CBD, Patpong/Suriwong nightlife, Surawong, the Charoen Krung riverside creative corridor, Saphan Taksin pier area and quiet blocks between. Research-verified: MahaNakhon inside (Si Lom khwaeng, Bang Rak side of Narathiwat Rd); St. Louis Hospital outside (Sathon district); Lumphini Park outside across Rama IV (Pathum Wan).
entities.selection_rationale: Second-highest district model score (2/50); distinguish Silom, riverside and other subareas.

entities.name_th: สัมพันธวงศ์
entities.scope_notes: Administrative khet — Bangkok's smallest district (~1.42 km², pop ~21,324 in 2020). Research-verified boundary caveats: the wider 'Chinatown' label is larger than the khet — the Soi Nana bar strip (Pom Prap Sattru Phai), Khlong Thom and River City (Bang Rak) lie outside; MRT Wat Mangkon station straddles the boundary; Wat Mangkon Kamalawat temple itself is attributed just outside the khet by source coverage.
entities.selection_rationale: Highest district model score (1/50); tourism/food identity must not be generalized across every street.

entities.scope_notes: 800 m straight-line catchment around BTS Ari (Sukhumvit line), entirely within Phaya Thai district (100% per app data) but not the whole khet. Residential grid around Soi Ari 1–5 and Phahonyothin Road. Coordinate checks placed every named public park outside the circle (Phaya Thai Palace ~1.80 km; Santiphap Park ~1.87 km; Vachirabenjatas/Rot Fai Park ~3.7 km to centroid) — the app's green 9 is not explained by any named public park source could confirm inside the unit (app park_ha 5.1 unverified against names).
entities.selection_rationale: Current guide coverage; investigate calm/leafy descriptions, actual public green access and day/night differences.

entities.name_th: อโศก / สุขุมวิท
entities.scope_notes: 800 m straight-line catchment around the BTS Asok / MRT Sukhumvit interchange; both physical stops share the single scored area st.asok. District split (app data): Watthana 51.3%, Khlong Toei 48.7% — it is not all of either district. Research-verified locations: Terminal 21 (~147 m) and Soi Cowboy (~121 m) inside; Benjakitti Park northeast tip ~460 m inside but main entrances and most of its area beyond 800 m; Benchasiri Park (~958 m) outside; Bumrungrad Hospital (~1.2 km) outside.
entities.selection_rationale: Recognizable interchange candidate with a high model rank (11/133); verify independent guide coverage.

entities.scope_notes: 800 m straight-line catchment around BTS Chong Nonsi (Silom line) on the Sathorn Road corridor. District split (app data): Bang Rak 68.4%, Sathon 31.6%. Boundary caveat (verified 2026-11-07 against the app polygon and Wikipedia coordinates): Sala Daeng BTS (~730 m) and the Patpong block (~657 m) lie within a bare 800 m straight-line of the stop but OUTSIDE the app's mapped catchment, because st.sala-daeng is itself a rated area whose nearest-stop catchment takes the Silom/Patpong block; the nightlife rating rests on the unit's own venue density, not Patpong. MahaNakhon (~122 m from the stop, Wikipedia coordinates) is inside.
entities.selection_rationale: Highest station-area model score (1/133); test whether public accounts agree and what the score misses.

entities.scope_notes: 800 m straight-line catchment around BTS Thong Lo (Sukhumvit line), covering the Soi Thong Lo (Sukhumvit Soi 55) mouth and adjacent blocks. District split (app data): Watthana 51.3%, Khlong Toei 48.7%. Venues deep up the soi or across the Phra Khanong canal (Ekkamai side) can fall outside the circle; the single-spine street layout is the defining access constraint. Not the whole Thonglor neighborhood or Watthana district.
entities.selection_rationale: Current user-selected area and current guide coverage; investigate the gap between editorial enthusiasm and a 6.5 model score.
